bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6”x 9” and clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6” are allowed. All bags are subject to search upon entry.
allowed: clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: General admission parking is included with your ticket. Upgraded options such as Premier Parking, Ultra Premier Parking, and Reserved Parking are available, with Reserved Parking ensuring a quick exit after the event. All parking lots are conveniently located on the east side of the venue.

rideshare.note: Rideshare drop off and pick up is available at 5150 Upper Ridge Rd., West Valley City, UT 84118.

concessions.note: Utah First Credit Union Amphitheatre offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Koko's Bavarian provides German-inspired sausages and pretzels, while general concessions offer popcorn, nachos, and a selection of beverages. CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream is also available in a convenient pouch.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The accessible entrance to our lawn accessibility section is located on the south & north sides of the front of the lawn, behind the 300s sections. The accessible entrance is a paved ramp that leads to the pit and is located on both the south & north side of the 200s sections.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Utah First Credit Union Amphitheatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Utah First Credit Union Amphitheatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Utah First Credit Union Amphitheatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
